note: Unlocks the full-budget search (scripts/r22_search.py). Run B is queued after A. The late stage stays closed until selection, freeze of both runs and the vault (scripts/r22_final.py). Operational detail: N2 is run as 3 jobs of 110 000 (seeds 1-3) and merged; if fewer than 300 000 distinct normal forms remain after merging, a top-up job is added before selection. The evaluator cache size (--cache-mb, 450 in the queue) only affects speed and memory.
